0022600002.text: Both teams have yet to play a 2026-27 game, and this is the 76ers' first of the season, with Philadelphia visiting New York; ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance of winning. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade, Dominick Barlow, Tacko Fall and VJ Edgecombe are all day-to-day with game-time decisions, while the Knicks have Josh Hart listed as day-to-day with ankle soreness. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and the most recent meeting, in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026, ended in a 144-114 loss for the 76ers.
